title: Distributed leaderboard
prerequisites: Heaps and partitioned top-k introduced here
learning_objectives: Propose and revise an inspectable architecture
problem_statement: Maintain a top-k leaderboard while scores arrive from many writers. Clarify tie handling, freshness and read-your-write expectations.

progressive_constraints.title: Ranking authority
progressive_constraints.description: Name the state that determines ordering and define tie behavior.

progressive_constraints.title: State budget
progressive_constraints.description: Estimate storage with replication against a declared storage budget.

progressive_constraints.title: Concurrent updates
progressive_constraints.description: Updates can arrive twice or out of order. Declare an update/version policy.

progressive_constraints.title: Partitioned top-k
progressive_constraints.description: Explain global merge and the permitted lag when a ranking shard is unavailable.

valid_architecture_families.name: Central sorted ranking index
valid_architecture_families.description: A sorted state service offers global order within its measured capacity boundary.

valid_architecture_families.name: Shard-local top-k plus merge
valid_architecture_families.description: Maintain bounded candidates per shard, merge globally, and state freshness/failure limits.

common_misconceptions: Top-k results require a stated tie policy.
Summing duplicate deltas can inflate scores.
Shard-local winners do not establish freshness of a global view.

hint_ladder.level_1: Decide whether equal scores share a rank or require a stable tiebreaker.
hint_ladder.level_2: Compare one sorted authority with shard-local candidate sets and a merge step.
hint_ladder.level_3: For 1M entries at 64 bytes with two copies, the raw state estimate is 128MB before index/allocator overhead. Version or deduplicate updates before deriving a global ranking.

consolidation: Ranking requires update semantics, stable tie handling and a freshness contract; raw payload bytes exclude engine overhead and operational headroom.
fresh_transfer_question: What changes when a contest closes and the final ranking must become immutable and auditable?
coach_instructions: One clear question at a time. Inspect actual graph and stated assumptions. Do not grade prose by keywords or require a vendor name. Numeric assumptions are learner declarations, not measured performance. Explain when asked, require teach-back, and preserve alternative valid designs. Do not silently edit the diagram.
